desc: Prove f(L,R) equals the count of values x present with x-1 absent (maximal runs of the distinct-value set).
Derive and verify the O(N) first-occurrence per-index formula.
Implement the O(N) first-occurrence algorithm in Python with fast input/output.
Handle sentinels/edge cases: x=1 has no x-1, absent occurrences, N=1, big-int answers.
Validate on samples (16, 23, 129) and confirm against hand computation for sample 2.
